title: Another Gaudi mastrrpiece
text: Very knowledgable guide picked us up for short walk to park side gate, told us about the park with suggestions for us and then arranged our entry. Fascinating park with typical Gaudi style and creations. Relaxing space with great views.

title: Good guide

title: Great visit
text: The visit was great, David explained everything very well so we could appreciate the details. I am clear that the visit without those explanations would be very different, although the price seems very high to me.

title: Easy way to enter Park Güell
